messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] message error "hessian matris is singular, try fewer  variables"
parts:
Hi Stéphanie,

Without replicate surveys per site you cannot fit the Mackenzie model.
I will add a better error message for this case. The one model that
might work is the Royle et al 2004 distance sampling model, which can
be fit using the distsamp function. Did you record distances?

Richard
